import { defineTable, col, rel, sql } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { customer } from "./customer";
import { inventory } from "./inventory";
import { staff } from "./staff";

export const rental = defineTable("rental", {
    columns: {
        rentalId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        rentalDate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
        inventoryId: col.integer().notNull(),
        customerId: col.integer().notNull(),
        returnDate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
        staffId: col.integer().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow(),
        uuid: col.uuid().notNull().unique().default(sql`uuidv7()`)
    },
    relations: {
        customer: rel.belongsTo(() => customer),
        inventory: rel.belongsTo(() => inventory),
        staff: rel.belongsTo(() => staff)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
